description: Update a project's mutable fields (e.g. name, format, brandKitId). Pass projectId + the changed fields as `body`. Setting brandKitId binds/changes the project brand kit so every render of this project themes from it. Returns the updated ProjectResponse.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: update_project

composition.description: Summary of a project's stored composition.

lastRender.description: Most recent render for a project, if any.

webUrl.description: A browser URL that opens THIS project, or null when CueFrame exposes no web view for a project. Null today: the console serves account surfaces (keys, usage, billing) and has no per-project page, so there is no link to give. Do NOT synthesise one — a guessed console path 404s. Show the user rendered output (create_render → outputUrl) or a preview still instead. This field becoming non-null is the signal that a real project view exists.

title: Update Project
